text: 2026年7月13日，应美国国内企业FirstSolar,Inc.、HanwhaQCELLSUSAInc.、TalonPV、SwiftSolar、GreatLakesSolexPR,LLC、DYCMPower,LLC、SunivaInc.和SilfabSolarInc.提交的申请，美国对原产于中国的晶体硅光伏电池（无论是否组装入模块）发起反规避调查，审查是否存在以下两种规避美国反倾销和反补贴税令的行为：
text_en: On July 13, 2026, in response to applications filed by US domestic companies First Solar, Inc., Hanwha QCELLS USA Inc., Talon PV, Swift Solar, Great Lakes Solex PR, LLC, DYCM Power, LLC, Suniva Inc., and Silfab Solar Inc., the United States initiated an anti-circumvention investigation into crystalline silicon photovoltaic cells (whether or not assembled into modules) originating from China, examining whether the following two behaviors circumvent US anti-dumping and countervailing duty orders:
